purpose: Define one owner for each dashboard metric and prevent duplicate paid collection.

gsc.rule: GSC is the only source used to select existing dashboard opportunity keywords.

dataforseo.rule: Request only exact GSC-selected dashboard keywords after approval.

seoagent.rule: Treat results as third-party strategy observations; do not use estimated performance values in GSC, GA4, or market-metric fields.

collection_guards: Never replace GSC or GA4 first-party metrics with third-party estimates.
Every paid request requires an explicit scope, cost ceiling, and user confirmation.
Never automatically retry a paid request.
Store each provider response separately by domain and collection month.
